## Strategy draft

I built a two-concept search for **knee osteoarthritis** and **mesenchymal stem/stromal cells**. Cell source terms are included within the cell block, but source is not a required third concept; that could exclude studies that report source only in the full text. No outcome, study-design, language, or species filters were added.

The complete PubMed query is saved as a single line in [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-1ed0294b794a32e7/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T110139Z/final_strategy.txt). The assumptions and search audit are in [audit_notes.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-1ed0294b794a32e7/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T110139Z/work/audit_notes.md).

I checked the MeSH records and trees for Osteoarthritis, Osteoarthritis, Knee, Mesenchymal Stem Cells, and Mesenchymal Stem Cell Transplantation, and tested the blocks and combined query with the bundled PubMed CLI. The exact final query returned 779 records from the live endpoint.

**Cutoff limitation:** The query includes the requested publication-date ceiling of 2022-05-10, but the live CLI still returned records whose abstracts describe work after that date. I did not use those records to derive search terms, and the endpoint could not validate the cutoff reliably. The CLI used current MeSH records, so I also could not verify historical 2022 entry-term wording.

This is a draft; have a second information specialist peer review it under PRESS before using it as the final search.
